snippet.title: Twilight Towers - Early Access Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Fernhollow is in peril. A mysterious mist has corrupted the land and creatures, and your ancient castle is under siege. Only your merge mastery, strategic tower defense skills, and legendary dragons can drive back the corrupted beasts, cleanse the darkness, and restore the kingdom’s glory.

• Merge & Upgrade Towers – Evolve your defenses through strategic merging and upgrades
• Collect Powerful Dragons – Train dragons with unique abilities to fight alongside your towers
• Expand Territory by Winning – Defeat enemy hordes to unlock new zones and grow your realm
• Counter Enemies with Unique Towers – Deploy Spell Cannons, Spinshot Towers, Catapult Towers, and more to unlock new strategies
• Puzzle-like Campaign Levels – Outsmart 100+ unique challenges through merging, resource management, and clever positioning
• Activatable Abilities – Turn the tide of battle with real-time dragon powers
• Merge Mastery – Combine towers, resources, gold, mana, and villagers for unstoppable growth
• Defend the Castle – Position your towers with precision to repel relentless enemy waves
• Monthly Events – Join limited-time events with new dragons, maps, and exclusive leaderboard rewards
• Organize Your Realm – Arrange and optimize your kingdom for maximum efficiency and satisfaction
• Level Up Your Castle – Transform your fortress from a modest keep to an unbreakable stronghold
• Customize & Augment – Enhance towers with hundreds of runes designed to counter specific threats
• Supercharge Growth – Optimize resources to grow stronger daily, even while idle
• Achievements & Quests – Earn rewards through daily quests and unlocking achievements
• Join a Guild – Team up with other players to share kingdoms, strategies, and rewards

Find out more at: http://www.twilighttowers.com/
